card.name: Digit 1 inside numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 1 (or a decimal point or comma) inside a number, often starting the next digits such as 10, 08 or 15. It is seen in lab values, dose tables, and section references.

modes.label: Leading 1 before more digits
modes.description: The digit 1 that starts a multi-digit number, such as 110, 108 or 115.
modes.example: diastolic blood pressure ><<1>>10 mm Hg) not adequately

modes.label: Separator or digit in tables
modes.description: A decimal point or comma, or another digit, in the middle of a number in a data table.

card.plain: It fires on a digit, mostly a 1, in the middle of a number in dose or lab-value text.
